panels.title: Selective outcomes and coverage
panels.description: Outcome shares require at least 10 selected attempts/responses. Comparator is all other observed peers on the exact same target IP, service port and time range; it is explicitly marked N/A when fewer than 10 control observations exist. TCP resets are post-establishment; HTTP 403/429 are not intent claims. Counters have no phase label, and client retries are separate attempts.

options.content:
## Profile → target/service outcome triage

Ranks observed TCP no-reply/refused and HTTP 403/429 shares with same-target/service peer controls. No comparison means fewer than 10 other observations. Evidence only; keep the time range within one game phase.

panels.title: Router capture status
panels.description: Ready only when the router exporter is reachable and the bounded relay-counter scrape succeeds. Missing data stays N/A.

panels.title: Selected source profile
panels.description: Live unique profile metadata from healthy Zeek; it exists independently of sparse outcome events and does not depend on board API inventory.

targets.expr: max by (source_ip, source_team_ip, source_team_name, member) (forcad:game_profile_info{source_ip="${profile}",source_team_ip=~"${source:regex}"} and on() group(forcad:game_sensor_ready))

panels.title: Historical router-denied packets
panels.description: Historical direct router-denied packets from team vulnbox → target vulnbox, using the router's source_team_ip counter and ignoring player/WG profile selection. Counted after source-spoof checks and before the deny rule; it is not a successful relay. N/A means router metrics are unavailable.

targets.expr: sum(increase(forcad_network_relay_attempt_packets_total{job="forcad_router",source_team_ip=~"${source:regex}",team_ip=~"${target:regex}"}[$__range]) and on (job, instance) (forcad_network_relay_scrape_success{job="forcad_router"} == 1 and on (job, instance) up{job="forcad_router"} == 1))

panels.title: Checker status and duration (separate service context)
panels.description: Recent checker CHECK outcomes from the restricted checker_action_events view. Status counts describe checker-reported service availability; duration is checker runtime, not network or HTTP request latency, and is not attributed to a peer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.service AS "Service", e.team AS "Team",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 101) AS "UP",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 102) AS "CORRUPT",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 103) AS "MUMBLE",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 104) AS "DOWN",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 110) AS "CHECK FAILED",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.timed_out) AS "Timeouts",
       round(avg(e.duration_ms)::numeric, 1) AS "Mean check duration ms",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.duration_ms) AS "p95 check duration ms",
       max(e.duration_ms) AS "Max check duration ms",
       max(e.time) AS "Last check"
FROM checker_action_events AS e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.time) AND e.action = 'check'
GROUP BY e.service, e.team
ORDER BY max(e.time) DESC
LIMIT 200
